entries.title: Portfolio Audit: India (NSE/BSE), Session of 23 October 2026
entries.summary: India portfolio audit for the 23 October 2026 session in a Downtrend: sell 11 positions (10 exits and the RNITAI trim) for about ₹1.88 million, buy nothing, raise cash from 0.09% to 45.0% and cut effective market exposure from 88.9% to 43.0%.
highlights: RNITAI is 23.52% of net worth against a 15% hard cap and fails the cash-conversion red line, so the Let-Winners-Run rule cannot protect it; trim 4,000 of 10,000 shares to 14.11%.

Four holdings (ASTRAMICRO, NETWEB, AFCOM, TDPOWERSYS) closed under their own written stops and six fail a red line (INTERARCH, TARIL, WELENT, ORIANA-SM, BLISSGVS, BALUFORGE): exit all ten at Monday's open.
No shortlisted company passes all three gates at a buyable price; seven conditional limit orders are sized by Risk-Unit Sizing but stay inactive until results and support conditions are met.
Nine retained positions each carry a written stop; money at risk to stops falls from 6.69% to 5.63% of net worth, inside the 12.0% ceiling; SEDEMAC at 14.47% is the largest remaining exposure.
NETWEB filed record results on Saturday 24 October, after the session cutoff; the stop rule that fired on Friday's close is kept and the event is disclosed.
